content: Hi there, I'm Jake Trevor. I'm a PhD student at the University of Glasgow, working on mechanising the semantics of quantum programming languages. Looking forward to chatting with you all!
Hey! I've also been working on formalising some quantum programming with @Marcel Mordarski - happy to chat:)
Hi! I'd also love to see work in this area find its way into #CSLib.

Yes that would be really good to see. At the moment, most of my work has dependency on mathlib; I didn't fancy re-formalising matricies when a perfectly good one already existed. I'm not sure how that would fit in to the CSlib program...
We depend on Mathlib so that part is not an issue!
